description: Local authority gas pipe infrastructure maps (Open variant) is a series of datasets listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. This data asset contains geospatial information of the gas pipes alongside some key attributes of these pipes in Maldon, owned by Cadent Gas Limited in its role as a Licensed Gas Transporter (GT). The data represents underground gas distribution pipes within the specified local authority. Coverage: 189 local areas (Amber Valley, Ashfield, Babergh, Barking And Dagenham, Barnet and others). The portal lists 189 near-identical datasets in this series, one per area, all with the same structure; they are grouped in this one record and each has its own page on the portal (the first few are linked). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence 3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
